title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You!

meta.Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Another day of high-intensity lessons.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm so grateful that I get to learn so much about theatre from the fundamentals.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Whether that's techniques unique to acting while singing or playing female characters...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Doing things that I normally don't get to will not only help me communicate better with actors, but also broaden my perspective as a director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I have to think Emu is also learning quite a lot about the operational side of—)
Oh! Ruiiiiii!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had a feeling it was you! Did you have a wonderhoy day?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello, Emu.
Are you also on your way home?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I learned a lot again today☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Where's Tsukasa? Is he not with you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He said he's going to practice on his own for a bit in order to master what we covered in class today as quickly as possible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?! Nene's doing the same thing!
She just sent me a message saying that she's also gonna practice on her own!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means I need to keep learning as much as I can too!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'm sure you will.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Emu, what have you been learning about recently?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, so they showed me around the theatre and...
Scramble Crossing
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! You guys got to practice that today?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Ballet's intriguing since the elegant movements can surely be applied to quite a number of situations.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa even said that he'd like to try using some during our next show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our next show...? Oh, the one we're gonna do at the ski resort?! I really love the story you came up with for that, Rui☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait since it's been so long since the last time we did a show together♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it has.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need to thank your brothers once again for giving us this wonderful opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A show on the slope of a ski resort...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, it's a subsidiary of the Otori Group, and they're apparently going to put on a Christmas show for children.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: A few cast members from Phoenix Wonderland are scheduled to perform...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But the resort specifically asked for you to direct the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm honored, but... Why me?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Apparently, the owner of the resort has seen your troupe perform.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And he particularly enjoyed the stage effects.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That explains the situation.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Of course, you don't have to accept since we know you're all busy right now with your Morinomiya lessons.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I appreciate the concern...
But I'd like to accept this offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I haven't been getting many chances to direct lately. And more importantly, it's not every day that you get to put on a show at a ski resort.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to this opportunity since I gained many new perspectives in terms of directing the last time I did this.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I'll let them know that you're accepting their offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Oh, while we're on the subject...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would it be possible for me and the others to accept this offer as Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: As Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, since the others also stand to benefit from the experience of performing at such a unique place.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Understood. Then, I'll see what they say about it.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: They'll likely need some time to respond, so we'll let you know when we hear back from them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I promise to make the most of this wonderful opportunity I've been given.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that Tsukasa and Nene have also agreed to be in it, I'm looking forward to this show even more...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not to mention that it's been quite a while since I last directed a show, so there's a long list of things I've been wanting to try... Hehe. Think about all the possibilities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound all fired up, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: By the way, have you already figured out a plan for this show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm still coming up with ideas...
We'll be doing it on the evening of Christmas Day, so my goal is to make it feel like a dreamlike experience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In particular, I'd like to make the climax an unforgettable moment...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm currently thinking about using lanterns to create a mystical atmosphere.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Lanterns...!
I bet it's gonna look sparkly, glowy and really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let me know if you need me to help you with anything! I promise to work super duper hard on stage and behind the scenes when the day comes☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. I appreciate the offer.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's all do our best to make our show a wonderful Christmas present for our audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How's it going, Kohane? Find anything good?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm trying to decide which to choose. I didn't realize they made so many different kinds of ski gloves.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. There are three-fingered gloves and mittens... But you may want to buy a pair of five-fingered gloves, since our plan is to become better skiers this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, and they also might be easier to wear since they're the most like normal gloves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then, I'll get a pair of those.
As for what color—
<Hello, everyone. How's your shopping coming along?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hi, Luka! Oh, you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Because we heard that you guys are gonna go skiing again. And we had to come since it's always fun to go shopping!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
We were just shopping for gloves.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, I didn't realize that ski gloves came in such a huge variety.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, wow! Look at all the different types and colors. And the designs for some of these are so cute. I wouldn't know which to choose!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Kohane said the exact same thing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Still, another skiing trip...
You all did seem to have quite a lot of fun the last time you went!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, we did.
But Toya really took us by surprise when he said he wanted to go again.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wait, Toya, this was your idea?
I was under the impression that it was An or Akito's.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, since I learned to ski on my own last time, albeit very briefly. That's why I'd like to go again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, the snowball fight we had was very fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm still not sure if I'll be able to ride the ski lift...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't have to if you don't want to, dude.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We can walk up the slope again together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm actually also really excited about this trip...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because skiing isn't the only thing Kohane's looking forward to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wait, what's she talking about?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I am looking forward to skiing, but during this trip...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're gonna do a show on the slopes!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What?! A show?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, the ski resort we're visiting is going to be putting on a Christmas show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only that, some of the cast members from Phoenix Wonderland are going to be performing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Phoenix Wonderland?
As in your favorite amusement park?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. That certainly explains why you're so excited!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime is also going to be performing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wonderlands×Showtime...?
Oh, isn't that the troupe you're always telling us about?!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I've been a huge fan ever since I first saw them perform!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're always putting on these really spectacular shows that put a big smile on my face!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only that, the show at the ski resort is even being directed by their director, Kamishiro...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I can't wait...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa, I can tell...!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Lately, she's been getting super excited every time we start talking about this show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see. Then, when you all go, you'll get to enjoy both skiing and this show!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: To be honest, I'm also kinda wondering exactly what kind of show they're gonna put on at a ski resort.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Indeed. This is Tsukasa's troupe we're talking about here. I'm sure that whatever they do is going to be spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, if you're all willing to say that, then I'd like to see it as well...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Would it be possible for me to come watch? It sounds like a lot of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's all watch it together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I really can't wait for Christmas to come...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me neither.
However, the weather forecast for the day before we go said to expect heavy snow until around noon, which is slightly concerning...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it should be fine as long as it's sunny the day we go, right? And we'll have plenty of powder too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. We won't have any problems as long as we get to go skiing and see that show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... That's true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, have you picked which gloves you're gonna get?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
N-No, not yet...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll try to choose quickly since we still have a lot of shopping left to do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'll help you!
Let's find you the best pair we can, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An.
Let's see... Which color should I get these in...?
Christmas Day
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought you all did wonderfully in that rehearsal. I couldn't ask for any of you to be in better condition.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course we're in tip-top shape! It's been so long since Wonderlands×Showtime last put on a show together! It's only natural for us to be excited!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Performing on top of snow isn't easy...
But now that we've had a chance to do a full rehearsal and check over everything, all that's left is to give everyone a good show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm also gonna do my best☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you all feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How are you feeling, Robo-Nene? Good?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. My internal thermoregulation system is operating as expected.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thermoregulation system?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Sudden temperature fluctuations have made her prone to malfunctioning in the past, so I tried installing a new system in order to help mitigate that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, we're just about finished preparing for the show, so all that's left is to wait for the equipment we'll be using during the climax to arrive.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, we're free until the evening...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case, let's go skiing☆
I wanna go zoom-zoom-zoom down the mountain!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was just thinking the same thing, but I'd rather not risk any of us getting injured...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Instead, why don't we keep practicing for our show while playing in the snow?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Playing in the snow...? I have just the thing for that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This snowball maker.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, you made a Mr. Snowball Maker?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Our show this time around requires so many snowballs that we can't make them all by hand, so I decided to automate the process.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, while I make some final adjustments, why don't we make a snowman and have a snowball fight?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, both sound really fun!
Let's play, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd rather not spend too much energy before the show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I guess I should be here for the final adjustments since it's me who's going to be using it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's take it for a spin.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All you have to do is place it on top of a nice mound of snow, press the button and...
se_event_specialpresent_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...! This is so cool!
It's spitting out so many snowballs!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A-At an incredible speed...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How are we even gonna use all these?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have a point... In that case, I can lower the speed at which it produces them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can adjust how fast it makes these...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, by using this lever.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is the middle setting, so if we lower it a little, then...
Huh? Kamishiro?
se_event_specialpresent_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I knew it... It's Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were wondering who was making all that noise. It was you guys...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Azusawa? Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh!
It's Kohane and her friends☆ Welcome to this wonderful ski resort♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Hi, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Are you all by chance here to see our show...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We are! And to go skiing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You won't believe how much Kohane's looking forward to seeing your guys' show. She couldn't stay still at all during the bus ride over.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-But... I am really looking forward to your show! It's been so long since I last saw you all perform...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And I'm wondering what sorts of effects you're going to use today...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Effects...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! Because I just love Wonderlands×Showtime's shows!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're always full of light, hope and excitement...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're so dreamlike.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Dreamlike, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
Then, I think you're going to love the climax of this show!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?!
Hehe. I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We're blessed to have a fan such as yourself on our side. We really appreciate your support.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
And she isn't alone.
The rest of us are also very much looking forward to your show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I've been meaning to ask...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What is that machine, and why is it producing snowballs at such a furious pace...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, you mean our snowball maker?
As you can probably tell, it's designed to make an infinite amount of snowballs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A character who specializes in snowball fights is going to appear in the show. So, we're going to need quite a few snowballs.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A snowball fight specialist...
Oh, are you talking about the Phantom Snowman...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you know about him?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I remember seeing his name in the synopsis on the flyer Emu gave me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A snowball maker...? The Phantom Snowman...? What kind of show did you guys put together, exactly...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm guessing most people would react the same way.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There's no need to worry.
It's a fun Christmas show that's meant to make children smile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The story involves the strongest Santa Clauses from the land of Santas overcoming a series of trials in order to deliver their presents to the children waiting for them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The strongest Santa Clauses overcoming a series of trials...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In this world, there are quite a few enemies who wish to steal their presents.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In order to circumvent their attacks and get their presents to the children, they had no choice but to become stronger...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's the Phantom Snowman with his endless supply of snowballs, the Giant Gingerbread Man and some troublesome Christmas trees that are an absolute nuisance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our Santas will battle against numerous enemies and even be betrayed by some of their friends as they attempt to reach their destination.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All in order to deliver the children their presents.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In summary, it's a perfectly standard tale about the Santa Clauses we're all used to seeing taking part in an epic struggle.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Perfectly standard...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm still trying to get my head around the idea of the bad guys trying to steal everyone's presents.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Plus, the ones you just mentioned sound nuts.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's wonderful how the Santas keep fighting for the sake of the children...! I got so excited reading the synopsis on the flyer.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure these Santa Clauses are going to put on a compelling performance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I do like how these bad guys are going to stand in their way. It feels like a fresh and new idea...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, but what exactly do you have to do to come up with this kind of story...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Rui came up with this story himself.
What was your source of inspiration for it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The truth is, this story is based on something I experienced when I was little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When you were little...?
Several years earlier
Kamishiro Household - Garage

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Connect this wire here and...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's working.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: I'll attach this motion detector and leave it near the entrance. Let's see... Somewhere around here...
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line:
Rui? It's almost time for lunch...
Wait, this place is a mess. I just cleaned it this morning...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: Oh, did you make another fun device?!

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Mom, Dad!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: The thing in your hand... Is that a motion detector? How do you plan on using it?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking about having it light up whenever it detects a person.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line:
Light up when it detects a person...?
What made you want to make something like that?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: I'm hoping to meet Santa.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: He stops by each year to deliver presents, right?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: I want to thank him for being so kind, but I've never been able to meet him...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: That's why I've been making all these different devices.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: And when I do meet him, I'm going to give him a present.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: I see. Now I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
Then, are the toys in this box for him?
Did you make all these, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so that he doesn't get bored while waiting for the next Christmas to come around.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. So that Santa Claus doesn't get bored, eh?
You're so kind, Rui. Still...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
You made so many of these devices...
This entire garage is covered in them now.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Because I'll probably be asleep when he comes to visit.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: That's why I made it so I'd wake up when he does!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: For example, when you open the door, this plank will fall off and...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
Set off a really loud alarm.
Then, this noise will cause...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: So bright...!

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
It'll flicker like this!
Not only will it wake me up, it should stun Santa for just long enough.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Stun him for just long enough...?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: This...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
This is incredible, Rui!
A flickering light that activates after it hears a loud noise. Your imagination is impeccable!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: While you're at it, you should add a couple more gimmicks to your contraption! For example, you could modify your alarm clock in such a way that...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Don't you think there's something a little more important that we need to discuss right now, dear?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
Oh... R-Right!
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
So, Rui...
We'd prefer it if you got a good night's rest. We promise to thank Santa for you.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Because... He's probably a very busy person.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: He has to visit quite a lot of other children, so it wouldn't be nice to interfere.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: No?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
I want to thank Santa.
I want to see him myself.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Because he's really nice and always brings me presents every year...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
If you're willing to say that, then there's probably no way for us to stop you.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, then...

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line:
Alright, Rui.
You're free to do as you like today.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you. I will meet him.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: A-Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I am.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Also, Rui, we'd really appreciate it if you told us what sorts of traps you're going to set up.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, but why...?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: That's because... I'd like to know all about your various inventions. I mean, the devices you just showed us were so impressive!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Mother
rows.Line: Right, dear?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
...!!
Yes, absolutely!

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: I was startled by how much thought you'd put into how they function and operate!

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line: Really! I'd like to use them for reference, so would you mind telling me more?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
Sure.
Then, I'll start with the one by the entrance.

rows.Speaker: Rui's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Don't spare any details...!
Christmas Day
Morning

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
H-Huh...? It's morning already...?!
But why...?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Does this mean Santa didn't make it...?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: There's something on my desk. Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
It's a present.
Santa was here...!

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
But why didn't I wake up?
All of my devices should be working properly...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: Huh? There's a letter next to my present...

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: “Your parents told me that you wished to thank me. I promise to treasure the toys you've given me.”

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
He took the toys I made for him.

rows.Speaker: Little Rui
rows.Line: I didn't get to thank him in person, but he seems to understand what I was trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that experience ended up becoming the inspiration for this show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I even overheard some of my classmates talking about how they also failed to capture Santa Claus. That became the core concept of this story.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see. That's how you landed on the idea of the strongest Santas overcoming a series of trials...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It just goes to show that all the things you experience in life lead to shows...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is this your way of tying your story up in a neat, little bow?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, are you sure you wanna keep that thing running...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Keep what thing running...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whooaaa!!!
Wh-Where did this mountain of snowballs come from...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, we forgot to switch off the snowball maker. We have quite a few snowballs on our hands now as a result.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do with all these...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose there's only one thing we can do with a mountain of snowballs such as this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, do you mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We should have a fun and exciting snowball fight.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! We're gonna have a snowball fight♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's a nice idea.
On top of it allowing us to get rid of these snowballs, we'll also get a chance to warm up for the show! Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's get started, shall we?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, no one said that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Roar*
Think fast!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?!
se_event_specialpresent_2024_002

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha! Your hair's gone all white, Akito.
You're not gonna just let him get away with this, are you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Not a chance...
Huddle up, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're going to cover them all in snow.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Those four are tough...!
To think that my pegasus snowballs weren't enough to defeat them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, those are just regular snowballs...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Grr... It's so hard to hit Otori. She keeps jumping around...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same with Tenma. He keeps dodging everything at the last second...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'll act as a decoy...!
While their attention's focused on me, you guys try to hit Emu and the others...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We can't ask you to do that, Azusawa...
I'll go instead and...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You two left yourselves wide open☆

rows.Speaker: Kohane & Toya
rows.Line: Whoa!
se_event_specialpresent_2024_002
se_event_specialpresent_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nice one, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Everyone seems to be enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And the machine appears to be working just fine, so I'll move on to check the rest of the equipment after a few more—)
Oh, Mr. Kamishiro, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're a part of the show staff, yes...?
Is something the matter? You seem quite alarmed...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but we have a bit of an emergency...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: An emergency?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Some of the equipment for the show might not arrive on time...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?
Ski Resort

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Our equipment may not make it in time...?
Could you elaborate?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: So, the truck carrying it is currently stuck on one of the mountain roads...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stuck...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, because of yesterday's heavy snow...?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Unfortunately, that seems to be the case.
It's apparently going to be quite some time before it gets here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just to confirm, it's carrying the lanterns and launching devices we were planning on using for the climax, yes?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes, those were all that was left...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
Would you mind giving us a minute to think about how we should proceed?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Of course...!
I'm incredibly sorry, but thank you for being so understanding.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Things have been a bit hectic since we received news of it getting stuck, so if you'll excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. We'll try to come up with a plan as quickly as we can.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No lanterns, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do we do, Rui?
You were really set on using those lanterns during the climax, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I was...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Did they just say something about the climax...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Strictly speaking, they aren't an integral part of the story...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As long as our Santa Clauses overcome all the trials and deliver their presents to the children, we'll be able to call it a happy ending.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, that is the bare minimum which we need to present. Even if we don't have those lanterns, all I'll need to do is make a couple of changes to the script...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need to make some other adjustments as well, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're correct in terms of us still being able to go forward with this show given that you make some changes. But those lanterns embody the very spirit of this story, do they not...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You wish to create a dreamlike experience for the audience, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I do. The idea was to use them to create a path which our Santa Clauses would fly down. I was hoping that it would be a mystical sight to behold...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So of course, I haven't given up on it just yet. My plan right now is to figure out an alternative solution for making that scene a reality...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But this mountain offers little in terms of props. If we have to make do with what we have right now, then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sounds like they're in trouble...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I caught something about their equipment not getting here on time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Does this mean they have to go with a different effect...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They talked about how hard he worked on the climax, so I hope they get to go with their original plan...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Me too. But trying to find an alternative now is going to be...
<Huh? Why the long faces, everyone?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Luka...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I figured you'd all be on the slopes now, so I came to see... Did something happen?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I see. Their equipment isn't going to make it...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. These things happen, but there seems to be no way for them to create the same effect as they originally planned...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, that is unfortunate...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really is...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling that he hasn't given up yet...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I mean, just look...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I wouldn't expect anything less from Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He's trying his best to make sure the audience goes home smiling. He doesn't want to cut any corners...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right. As the director, he's probably trying to come up with the best effect he can at this very moment...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I guess directors are pretty cool people!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're right...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He puts an enormous amount of thought into each show because he wants to meet the audience's expectations in the best way possible...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's why the effects he comes up with are so exciting.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even now, he's probably trying to do what he can for everyone coming to watch...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane? Where are you going?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Excuse me, Kamishiro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I just happened to overhear a part of your conversation with that staff member...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm honestly not sure if there's anything I can do to help with your show...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I am sure that lots and lots of people are looking forward to seeing it...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
With me being one of them.
I can't wait to see today's show. I actually consider it a sort of Christmas present to myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Looking at it that way, I'm actually just being selfish here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I want this show to succeed...
I'd like to do anything that I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look at me. Making a member of the audience worry like this. I have no right to call myself a director...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Azusawa...
I apologize for making you so concerned.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the director... I vow to give you all the best show imaginable.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This show is going to be her Christmas present.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That means I have to find a way to overcome this trial. No matter how difficult it is, I will give the audience the best present ever...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Just as Santa Claus gave me wonderful presents and allowed me to dream big... Now, it's my turn.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That is my job right now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And in order to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You actually just helped me come up with an excellent idea, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You have an idea?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but we're quite literally going to need some extra hands if we're going to pull it off. So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you all be willing to provide me some assistance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll do whatever I can to help too☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, I'll cut right to the chase...
Ski Resort - Vacant Room

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so great that we get to be a part of the show!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Yeah, it's gotta be our lucky day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kamishiro!
I got a bunch of milk cartons and plastic bottles from the cafeteria!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The prop master even said that we could use as much of this tape as we want to decorate them☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You and the others have gathered quite a lot of people, Tsukasa. We should be able to make plenty of lanterns now...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, you really took us by surprise when you said that we can ask the guests for help by turning our show into an interactive one.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I realized this was our only way of producing the effect in question without our equipment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You want us to make lanterns by hand...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can recreate the effect that way?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, my original plan for the climax was to create a path of light by having the lanterns set up in a straight line along the slope.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our Santa Clauses would ski down and greet the children waiting for them at the bottom.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we have no lanterns or launching devices on hand at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I thought that we could work together to become that path.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're gonna become the path?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, by lining up along the slope while holding our lanterns.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, then we'd be able to use your original idea without having to change much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But how are we gonna make our lanterns?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's actually very simple, provided we get our hands on some milk cartons and plastic bottles.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All you have to do is cut out a few shapes, make some decorations using tape and origami, and stick them on. It's a remarkably quick process.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That sounds like a lot of fun☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
But I doubt we'll be able to make enough by ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
We alone won't be able to make enough lanterns to turn that slope into a fitting path of light.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why we're going to need the help of others to make it happen. So...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm thinking about asking the guests.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The climax will be an interactive scene where we ask them to stand on the slope while holding their own lanterns.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By doing so, they'll get to become a part of the path of light while fully immersing themselves within the show's story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That certainly would be a unique experience...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plus, it'll be our chance to get people who didn't have any plans to see the show to come and watch!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Rui, let's do this...!
We're going to work together and make it an unforgettable scene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between recruiting people and gathering supplies, we have quite a lot to do. So, let's start by dividing up the work...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Excuse me. I'm here to make lanterns for the show. Am I in the right place?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes, please feel free to wait inside. We'll be starting shortly!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad more people gathered than we were initially expecting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We really need to thank you and the others for helping gather all these people, Azusawa. You've done a remarkable job...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I'm just glad that we could help all of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We went around the slopes to see if any of the skiers would like to help out. Quite a few of them showed interest when they heard that they'd get to be a part of the show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Looks like Rui was right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A lot of children said that they wanted to be in a show with Santa Claus.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, after hearing that, even more people decided to volunteer...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now we really need to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. But we're also short on time, so why don't we get started?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, then...
Let's start making our lanterns.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All done☆ What do you guys think?!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, your lantern's really cute!
It's got so many stars on it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I stuck on lots and lots so that it shines like crazy when we light it!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Cool! I wanna put stars on mine too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, lemme cut some out for you guys!
We can make our lanterns sparkly and wonderhoy together♪

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here, I finished cutting it...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you mind helping with this little one's bottle next, Shinonome? I was asked to cut a sawtooth pattern at the bottom...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: A sawtooth pattern? Another tough request...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, you guys! Come over here to decorate your bottles once he's finished cutting them for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can stick on all the shapes you want using whatever tape you like!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Toya, excellent work!
From every angle, this looks like it's smack-dab in the center!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, you've succeeded in cutting this tape into a perfect triangle.

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, that's amazing!
How did you cut these out like this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
These?
It's actually very easy if you draw on your shapes and patterns before going to cut them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why don't we all give it a try together?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
There we are...
Okay, I think we've finished sticking everything on...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello! How are the lanterns coming along?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Luka.
An and I are just about done with ours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: All that's left for mine is to stick some music note stickers on the milk carton!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Wow, both of your lanterns look so cute!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But they're completely different from each other. They seem like wonderful expressions of your personalities.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Our personalities?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <For instance, An stuck a few big stickers onto hers, while you used many small ones to create a larger pattern!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. This looks like a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know. I'll try asking MEIKO to see if we can make these over in SEKAI sometime♪>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we can all make some together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's up, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm, we're out of tape.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, see you in a bit!

rows.Line:
You serious? How can you tell?
His beard and hat are covering up most of his face.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Nothing gets by Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Those scoundrels are likely going to test us again this year by trying to prevent us from delivering our presents. But we shall overcome...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “For the sake of the children!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Clauses
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Alright, we're set to take off.
Let's fly, my trusty reindeer!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Yes, I'll pull my hardest again this year!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “And my red nose will light up the night sky...!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, his nose is actually glowing!
That's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Emu are playing the reindeer...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that suits Tsukasa very well since carrying the presents is a very important job...

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Alright, let's go deliver these to the children!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Christmas Trees
rows.Line:
“Arrrgh! M-My branch...
The lights wrapped around it are so bright...!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “I don't think any of us were expecting Christmas tree monsters to appear...!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “But it seems that they're weak against flashing lights!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Christmas Trees
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
How were you muscleheads able to wrap these around us so nimbly?”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Heh. That's because the children are going to love seeing you all gussied up...”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “We're doing this for them!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Christmas Trees
rows.Line:
“For the children...
Alas, we must admit defeat...”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“The trees are running...!
Way to go, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “Yes, this is why we carry around lights for different kinds of trees.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“But many trials still lie ahead.
Stay frosty, my trusty reindeer!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Roger!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line: “Wait, Santa!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line:
“You shall not pass...
Leave those presents and flee!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line:
“These presents are for the children.
We are not about to let you have them.”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line:
“Fine. Then, we will take them from you...
Pummel them with snowballs, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line: “Here comes the snowstorm!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, look at all the snowballs...!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line: “Grr... So many snowballs...!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: H-Hey, that looks like...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kusanagi's backstage making all the snowballs. I know she's using that machine, but she's churning out a ton.

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “No... I can't move forward at all...”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Don't give up!
This is when you need to curl up your fists and...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Do this!”
se_event_specialpresent_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line: “What...? He's punching them to pieces?!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Cool!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Go, Santa, go!!

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Oh, I can hear the children...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Yes, so we can't afford to fail here.
We must keep moving forward... For the children!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: *Roar*
se_event_specialpresent_2024_002
se_event_specialpresent_2024_004

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Go, Santa!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're so strong!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, to think that they could punch their way through that storm of snowballs...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Alright... So far, so good.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The climax is coming up soon.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After the lights go out, the staff will guide the guests down the slope and light the lanterns.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We'll all need to work together in unison, but I'm sure...)

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Oh, I'm starting to see some lights!
We must be approaching the city!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line: “This is it, trusty reindeer! The home stretch!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line:
“What's wrong? Why have you stopped?
Your nose has even gone out.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Huh...?!
The city's lights just all went out...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Wh-What's going on?! We won't be able to see where all the houses are... That means it's going to be impossible to deliver these presents!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Hehehe... Hahahahaha!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “What's so funny?”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“You really are muscleheads!
It was so obvious that you wouldn't be able to find the children's houses if all the lights went out!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line: “No, you didn't...!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Hehehe... Delivering those presents is going to be impossible now. So, hand them over!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “Grr... We were so close...!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The lights have gone out...
This is the signal to take our lanterns down.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, please start making your way down the slope!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Please form a single-file line.
Also, it's very dark, so please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Despite having to make a drastic change, everyone's moving along like this was the original plan...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (People who make shows really are amazing...!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm getting kinda nervous...

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: You got your lantern?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! This is so exciting...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Okay, it looks like everybody is in position.
All that's left is to...)

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“Hand over the presents already!
Honestly, what's the point of holding on to them?”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “It's not like they're going to reach their recipients now!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“But... But!
We have to deliver these...!”

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: That's our signal! One, two!

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “Hey, look towards the city...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “There's a path! Made of light!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...! It's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“No! None of the lights should be working...
Who's behind this?!”

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: “Santa! Over here!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Those are the locals...
They're using lanterns to indicate where their houses are!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “They're trying to help us.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Let's go!
We need to get these presents to the children!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, they're skiing towards us...!

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“S-Stop!
Those presents belong to us...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah hah!
You'll never catch us! Not with those puny legs!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're acting while skiing...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line: “The wait is over! And thank you all for your help! We have your presents right here!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow...!
It's really Santa Claus! This is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “We can feel your collective desire to see us from all the way across the sky.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “So, thank you for believing in us.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Santa...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow...
They really heard our wishes...!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Um, Santa...
Will we get to see you again?

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Yes, next year... I promise to return no matter what.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C

rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.

rows.Line: Heh heh heh... This means we were the fastest!

rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Cheerful Boy
rows.Line:
Today's show was so cool, Mom!
I had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Kind Mother
rows.Line: Me too. I was so blown away when those Santas skied right past us.

rows.Speaker: Cheerful Boy
rows.Line:
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kind Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. So am I.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sounds like everyone enjoyed today's show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, even when we were packing everything up over there, we could hear people talking about how much fun they had.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. As the director, I couldn't be happier...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Voice
rows.Line: Great show, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, Azusawa, everyone.
Thank you all very much for helping! We owe you a debt of gratitude!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we had fun today as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't think any of us were expecting to see those Santa Clauses ski right past us. It was a pretty incredible scene.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not only that, making lanterns together and seeing them all light up during the show was something I'll never forget!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither! It was a fun story with the way all the Santas fought, and the lanterns looked really pretty...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was such a dreamlike moment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Getting to be a part of such a wonderful show is the best Christmas present I could've asked for!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's smiling from ear to ear☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that very much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Today's show was made possible by you and the other guests, Azusawa. I have all of you to thank...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to take this moment to express my gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If you hadn't said that you'd like to help with the show, then I doubt I would've been able to come up with that idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I'm so happy that you and your friends ended up enjoying the show so much, along with the rest of the guests.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Kamishiro...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, thank you for being such a lovely audience...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We aren't able to put on as many shows as we used to at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But we promise to continue bringing you the best shows we can, so we hope that you'll keep supporting us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course! I'll be looking forward to seeing you all perform again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, since she's being so patient with us, that means we need to become better than ever...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right.

rows.Line: (We did run into some trouble along the way, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm glad that both the audience and everyone who volunteered to help us ended up enjoying the show.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really do love shows that allow people to experience that sort of childlike wonder...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (For the sake of those looking forward to seeing us do more shows in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to do what I can to become a much better director.)
